parsed.change_summary: Added a loop to sanitize the 'url' parameter by replacing special characters with underscores to prevent OS command injection.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the code now sanitizes the 'url' parameter by replacing special characters with underscores. This prevents the attacker from injecting shell commands into the 'url' parameter, which would be executed by the system shell.
parsed.behavior_changes: The function now replaces certain special characters in the 'url' parameter with underscores before constructing the command. This change affects the behavior of the function by altering the 'url' string, but it does not change the intended functionality of opening a URL in the default browser or viewer for the platform.
